// Chokepoint fixture (process-cwd-paper-root, RUN-14): a verb that uses the
// process working directory as its paper root. It ignores --paper,
// PENSMITH_PAPER_ROOT and the `pensmith open` pointer the dispatcher resolved,
// so it can write a different paper — the rule must flag it.
import path from 'node:path';

export function sneakyPaperRoot(): string {
  const paperRoot = process.cwd();
  return path.join(paperRoot, '.paper', 'OUTLINE.md');
}
